data.name: Kritartha
data.gender_notes: Kritartha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has accomplished or achieved his goals or desires. The name Kritartha carries the meaning “Achieved, accomplished” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kritartha usually hope their child will grow to embody achieved, accomplished and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the attainment of spiritual and material goals
data.etymology: Kritartha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Achieved, accomplished.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kritartha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, the name "Kritartha" is a mark of accomplishment and success. It signifies a person who has worked hard and has achieved their goals and desires in life. This name is often given to children as a source of inspiration and motivation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kritartha" holds deeper meaning. It represents the idea that one's efforts and actions in this life will ultimately bear fruit, and that the journey towards achieving one's goals or desires is a sacred one. The name serves as a reminder that every action we take, no matter how small, contributes to the greater purpose of our existence. In this way, the name "Kritartha" inspires us to live our lives with purpose and meaning, and to always strive towards our goals with dedication and determination.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kritartha: One who has accomplished or fulfilled their desires and is now focused on the ultimate spiritual journey towards Moksha or liberation.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Kritartha continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
